title: 1994 Air Force holographic projector concept

tellings.quote: In 1999, reporter William Arkin wrote an article about a 1994 Air Force concept for a holographic projector,

plain: In 1994 the US Air Force is said to have looked at an idea for a holographic projector, a device that could make images appear in the air. Michels tells this himself, drawing on a 1999 article by the reporter William Arkin. He raises it because such a device could, in principle, produce things in the sky that people might take for real craft.
